{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
# This will handle any non-numeric strings by turning them into NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
invalid_revenue_count = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries: {invalid_revenue_count}")

# Check for any negative or zero revenue values
print(f"Number of zero or negative revenue entries: {df['revenue_numeric'].le(0).sum()}")

# Check the distribution of revenue values
print("\nRevenue summary statistics:")
print(df['revenue_numeric'].describe())"}
